problem_text:
A logistics company needs to schedule 9 cargo shipments through 9 different port terminals.

Each shipment consists of a sequence of terminal processing steps represented as (Terminal, Hours), 
where each pair specifies the terminal where the processing must occur and the number of hours required. 
The order of pairs indicates the mandatory sequence in which the terminal processing must be completed.

Shipment details:
* S1 requires the sequence: (T7, 8) → (T5, 10) → (T1, 5) → (T9, 7) → (T2, 4) → (T6, 1) → (T4, 9) → (T3, 9) → (T8, 8)
* S2 requires the sequence: (T2, 3) → (T4, 7) → (T9, 8) → (T8, 7) → (T6, 5) → (T1, 10) → (T5, 4) → (T3, 9) → (T7, 1)
* S3 requires the sequence: (T9, 10) → (T7, 8) → (T2, 8) → (T6, 10) → (T4, 7) → (T8, 6) → (T1, 9) → (T5, 4) → (T3, 2)
* S4 requires the sequence: (T5, 5) → (T4, 7) → (T3, 6) → (T6, 6) → (T7, 4) → (T2, 2) → (T9, 5) → (T8, 5) → (T1, 4)
* S5 requires the sequence: (T2, 4) → (T4, 5) → (T8, 9) → (T5, 6) → (T9, 7) → (T3, 2) → (T1, 10) → (T6, 8) → (T7, 8)
* S6 requires the sequence: (T2, 7) → (T3, 4) → (T6, 1) → (T1, 10) → (T5, 3) → (T8, 1) → (T9, 7) → (T7, 7) → (T4, 6)
* S7 requires the sequence: (T7, 10) → (T9, 9) → (T1, 4) → (T3, 3) → (T4, 6) → (T8, 7) → (T5, 3) → (T6, 9) → (T2, 5)
* S8 requires the sequence: (T8, 3) → (T4, 1) → (T6, 1) → (T1, 8) → (T3, 5) → (T2, 5) → (T5, 9) → (T7, 1) → (T9, 7)
* S9 requires the sequence: (T8, 1) → (T3, 8) → (T1, 9) → (T2, 4) → (T7, 5) → (T4, 7) → (T6, 1) → (T5, 7) → (T9, 8)

Each terminal processing operation must run continuously once initiated and cannot be interrupted, 
and each terminal can only handle one shipment's processing at a time.
The objective is to determine the processing sequence of all operations at the terminals 
so that the total completion time for all shipments is minimized.
